changesApplied.changeMade: Added new config section with 6 fields: enabled, auto_evolve_on_staleness, staleness_threshold_days, auto_debug_on_failure, failure_threshold_count, max_evolution_frequency_hours. All have sensible defaults (enabled by default, 3 failure threshold, 30 day staleness, 168h evolution frequency).
changesApplied.reason: Enables configuration control over automated lifecycle behaviors. Users can now tune when templates are auto-debugged (failure threshold) and auto-evolved (staleness threshold). Without this config, lifecycle automation would be hardcoded and inflexible.
changesApplied.impactAnalysis: Low blast radius - New optional config section, backward compatible. All fields have safe defaults. Consumed by boredom-manager.ts and activity.ts to decide whether to trigger meta-templates. No breaking changes to existing functionality.

changesApplied.changeMade: Added template mapping before execution: templateMapping = {'improve-template': 'evolve-activity-self-contained', 'debug-failures': 'debug-activity-self-contained', 'optimize-performance': 'optimize-activity-self-contained'}. Now executes mapped meta-template with original template_id as 'templateId' variable, not the stale template itself.
changesApplied.reason: CRITICAL FIX for self-improvement loop. Previously, boredom system fetched 'improve-template' activities but executed the stale template directly. This didn't improve anything - just re-ran broken code. Now correctly executes evolve-activity-self-contained meta-template which analyzes metrics and generates improved version.
changesApplied.impactAnalysis: Medium blast radius - Changes boredom execution flow. Only affects executeBoredomActivity() which is called from monitorIdleActivity(). Impact: Stale templates now actually get improved. Requires meta-templates to exist (they do - bootstrap templates). May log warnings if optimize-activity-self-contained doesn't exist yet (TODO). Self-improvement loop now functional.

changesApplied.changeMade: Added helper function (lines 3310-3375) that checks config and triggers debug-activity-self-contained when activities fail. Calls executeActivityInline() with 'debug-activity-self-contained' template and {executionId: activity.id}. Invoked after activity.status='failed' in executeActivityInline() (line 1589).
changesApplied.reason: CRITICAL FIX for automated failure analysis. Previously, activities failed and saved status='failed' but no follow-up action. Now automatically triggers debug-activity-self-contained to analyze failures using activity_error_inspector MCP tool, generating EXECUTION_ANALYSIS.md and FIX_RECOMMENDATIONS.md. Completes self-improvement loop: fail → analyze → recommend → fix.
changesApplied.impactAnalysis: Medium blast radius - Adds background debugging after failures. executeActivityInline() is widely used (ActivityTool.execute(), BoredomManager, lifecycle hooks). Impact: All failed activities now trigger auto-debug. Non-blocking (wrapped in try-catch). Debug runs in separate session, doesn't interfere with parent. May increase background load if many failures occur. Respects config.auto_debug_on_failure flag.
